objective: Preserve both assessed root purposes and late observed realizations, and select the core idea by its relevance to the actual choice rather than the first matching motif.

preservation.policy: Keep prior source changes and historical verdicts; no staging, reset or commit. Compare edited files to this turn's baseline, not only HEAD.

audit_findings: Prepared-idea delivery displaces the two-root account while its reference arm can contain only a PV.
The exchange closure endpoint discards a later witnessed realization in the same reported PV (Re2 ...Nd5 ...Rxe5 ...Rae1).
First matching or lexically ordered preparation and work completion do not establish relevance to the root comparison.

constraints.validation: Existing Re2 and one preregistered new position only. Focused semantic checks and boundary checks for changed contracts; no broad regression or extra quality positions. Tests or added text alone cannot complete this goal.

reference.title: Jacob Aagaard, Grandmaster Preparation: Positional Play
reference.lesson: The important idea depends on the opponent's resources and the useful remaining pieces; an incidental relation or a legal example alone is not its priority.

cases.criteria: Both actual assessed roots retain a useful purpose account; explain rook coordination and reply-dependent order/cost. If the same reported line contains late Rae1 after the bishop exchange, preserve that realization and its complete cost. Do not force Be5 as the reference.

cases.hypothesis: Qa4 supports the change toward d4-d5 and pressure on the light squares while the h6 bishop is away; Nf4 is a different useful plan in the book. The actual engine reference, responses and costs remain authoritative.
cases.criteria: Explain the original queen move's useful idea and the actual other root's purpose, connect observed continuation and costs, and do not promote incidental attacks/supports or a book sentence into the causal comparison. Missing evidence must remain a limitation.

implementation: One combined ReferencePurposeReading retains the actual two-root account plus MoveIntent preparation and reply branches. The root mechanism reader is shared by scheduling and delivery.

Close each observed first realization and its exchange, rather than stopping before a late realization or expanding to the whole PV. Keep actual root paths when a child PV has the same first three moves but a different ending.

Rank useful physical relationships seen in either assessed root or an independent all-legal reply survey. If neither root provides a useful witness, survey replies before testing a tentative action; reselect the question from its evidence. A legal contact alone is not admitted as the core idea.
Retain exact short witness paths even when their moves already prefix a longer reported PV. They remain discovery-only and do not acquire engine evaluation authority.

Recognize the same physical preparation in both roots; distinguish transposition into the same arrangement from different costs. Use existing pawn-work tracking to explain a different original pawn taking over after an exchange.
Reject actions lacking either a cleared route or newly created root pressure before their local replay; this preserves the previous admission conditions.
The 10-second app target depth is now 11 (was 12), leaving room for the pair, reply survey and action comparison. Maximum analysis depth remains 18.

For purposes grounded in an actual root, the first useful observed relationship precedes survival in priority. An exchanged original user does not demote the earlier plan below a later incidental contact.

verdict.basis: Final common source explains both actual roots and response costs in two actual timed screens; exact prior reported continuations preserve late realization, and failed root/survey variants exercise core re-selection. Sentence addition or test success alone is not the completion basis.

limitations: Only the existing Re2 and one preregistered Qa4 position are quality cases; iterations are not independent heldout successes.
Candidate generation remains bounded to represented preparations. This does not solve all strategic purpose discovery or human importance ranking.
Finite PVs can omit the idea. Absence is not evidence that the plan is impossible; unsupported candidates cannot be promoted to core assertions.
No claim of decomposing the engine score, universal ten-second stability, broad regression coverage, or release readiness.

The final D11 Re2 screen does not contain the old late Rae1 continuation. Preservation of that late realization is demonstrated with its exact earlier reported line, not represented as newly observed in the last timed run.
D12 repeatedly failed the ten-second runtime budget for Re2. D11 is a product policy tradeoff, not evidence that D12 became fast. Root reference and PV may change; both actual choices are kept.
The combined basic account is still long in some branches, with repeated root/endpoint phrases and some repeated shared costs. This task does not establish complete concision or release quality.
